amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount (post-discount, pre-credit) in fractional cents (minor units).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency code for the cost amount. Currently always `"USD"`.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Number of API requests in this row's scope. Null when `group_by` includes `cost_type` or `token_type` (the count has no per-component attribution; read it from the ungrouped response). For sandbox / code-execution events, this counts execution spans rather than HTTP requests (these rows surface with `product: null`).
